description: This file defines a Java service class `FundTransferService` responsible for handling fund transfer operations within an internet banking application. It manages initiating fund transfers, updating transaction statuses, and retrieving transfer records with pagination.

classes.name: FundTransferService
classes.description: Service class managing fund transfer operations including initiating transfers, updating statuses, and retrieving transfer records.

methods.name: fundTransfer
methods.description: Initiates a fund transfer by saving a pending transaction, calling external banking service, updating transaction status upon success, and returning response.

methods.name: readAllTransfers
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all fund transfer DTOs.
